environment.device_kind: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

condition.port_featurizer: foldjax.models.opendde.data.featurize_json.featurize_opendde_json, re-run in this checkout (n_queries 32, n_keys 128, max_msa_depth 16384)
condition.name_mapping: fields both sides spell the same; derived fields (relp, MSA mask, counts) are listed as only-in-one-side

condition.backend: gpu (NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition)
condition.matmul_precision: JAX default: the port pins none (TF32 float32 dots on a GPU; jax_default_matmul_precision in the scope: None)
condition.input: re-capture native-input.npz + native-derived.npz (bitwise equal to the stored capture's: True / True)
condition.tape: re-capture torch/tape.npz + torch/msa.npz (bitwise equal to the stored capture's: True / True)
condition.kernels: port defaults: single/diffusion attention xla_jit, triangle attention cueq_jit, triangle multiplication xla on the narrow trunk (_with_cueq_triangle_defaults)
condition.trunk_dtype: bfloat16 (shipped default; native TF32 float32 trunk)

headline.metric: relative RMS single (s) / pair (z); residue trunk, then structural refiner

condition.backend: gpu (NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition)
condition.matmul_precision: JAX default: the port pins none (TF32 float32 dots on a GPU; jax_default_matmul_precision in the scope: None)
condition.input: re-capture native-input.npz + native-derived.npz (bitwise equal to the stored capture's: True / True)
condition.tape: re-capture torch/tape.npz + torch/msa.npz (bitwise equal to the stored capture's: True / True)
condition.kernels: port defaults: single/diffusion attention xla_jit, triangle attention cueq_jit, triangle multiplication xla on the narrow trunk (_with_cueq_triangle_defaults)
condition.injected_native: stages.npz diffusion.in.{s_inputs, s, z} (the structural tensors run_sample_diffusion_stage received) at structural_token_expand / structural_refiner_stack; residue trunk from residue_trunk.out; torch/tape.npz noise schedule, initial/step noise, rotations, translations

headline.metric: per-sample all-atom / CA RMSD (A), worst sample

S4_diffusion.notes: Reference: the re-capture's own sampler output (diffusion.out.coordinate), from the tensors injected here.

condition.backend: gpu (NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition)
condition.matmul_precision: JAX default: the port pins none (TF32 float32 dots on a GPU; jax_default_matmul_precision in the scope: None)
condition.input: re-capture native-input.npz + native-derived.npz (bitwise equal to the stored capture's: True / True)
condition.tape: re-capture torch/tape.npz + torch/msa.npz (bitwise equal to the stored capture's: True / True)
condition.kernels: port defaults: single/diffusion attention xla_jit, triangle attention cueq_jit, triangle multiplication xla on the narrow trunk (_with_cueq_triangle_defaults)
condition.injected_native: stages.npz confidence.in.{s_inputs, s_trunk, z_trunk} replace pairformer_output_from_s_inputs; confidence.in.x_pred_coords replace sample_diffusion; summaries vs the re-capture's raw.npz

S5_confidence.notes: Logits are compared with the re-capture's confidence-head outputs; the released summaries with its raw.npz (the port's postprocess on the port's logits).

condition.backend: gpu (NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition)
condition.matmul_precision: JAX default: the port pins none (TF32 float32 dots on a GPU; jax_default_matmul_precision in the scope: None)
condition.trunk_dtype: bfloat16 (shipped default; native TF32 float32 trunk)
condition.kernels: port defaults: single/diffusion attention xla_jit, triangle attention cueq_jit, triangle multiplication xla on the narrow trunk (_with_cueq_triangle_defaults)
condition.injected_native: tape.npz (noise schedule, initial/churn noise, rotations, translations) + msa.npz per-recycle MSA rows
condition.samples_x_steps: 5 x 200 (all samples; the parity subset replays sample 0 only)

headline.metric: per-sample all-atom / CA RMSD (A), worst sample

S6_final.notes: end_to_end_confidence compares the replay's own confidence with raw.npz; it is not S5, which needs the native trunk injected.
